source_refs.note: Topic 7.6.1 (PDF 188, printed 185). MCQ 10 is answered (b), matching the key.

blocks.text: Responsible digital behaviour means using technology respectfully and safely: use strong passwords that are hard to guess, mixing letters, numbers and symbols instead of something like 'password123', and avoid phishing by not clicking suspicious links and verifying any email that asks for account details.
